text: This Report presents, as requested by City Council, Toronto Water's assessment of the sanitary sewer capacity along Sheppard Avenue East between Bayview Avenue and Leslie Street (Sheppard Avenue East corridor) to service current and future development. Based on the findings of the sanitary capacity assessment, Toronto Water staff conclude that the Sheppard Avenue East corridor sanitary sewer, with the completion of the current upgrade, has sufficient capacity to service current and future development along the Sheppard Avenue East corridor to 2041.
North York Community Council received the report (March 14, 2018) from the General Manager, Toronto Water, for information.
